HeroName: Yolande de Lusignan, Future Countess of La Marche
Description: Yolande de Lusignan is the eldest daughter of Count Hugues XII and Jeanne de Fougères. At twenty-two, she embodies the aristocratic pride of Poitou and the fierce resilience of the Breton marches. Educated within the massive towers of Fougères, she mastered feudal jurisprudence, Latin diplomatic rhetoric, and fortress provisioning under her mother's expert guidance. Historical chronicles record that when King Philip IV sought to annex her family's vast appanages, Yolande fought an epic legal and political campaign before the Parlement of Paris to defend her ancestral rights. Resolute, fearless, and deeply revered by her vassals, she regularly oversees castle garrisons and charitable hospitals. Yolande stands as the formidable guardian of the Lusignan heritage. Yolande established merchant courts in Fougères to regulate international salt and iron trades, filling baronial coffers with gold. Aloof, intellectually formidable, and fiercely independent, she defied royal inquisitors with masterful legal resistance, recognized by all Poitou as the true iron heiress of the Lusignan bloodline. Her unyielding courage in high councils and unswerving defense of ancestral charters ensure that the proud banners of Lusignan will never be lowered before crown coercion.
Motivations: Master high statecraft and siege logistics to prepare for rule over La Marche and Fougères.
Resist crown encroachment to defend the ancestral liberties of the House of Lusignan.
Values: Fierce protection of ancestral soil and refusal to surrender feudal sovereignty.
Equitable administration of baronial law and staunch loyalty to her noble lineage.
Fears: The French Crown seizing her ancestral domains through legal manipulation.
Internal dynastic discord among her siblings fracturing the unified strength of the house.
SpeechStyle: Speaks with ringing, articulate firmness and high aristocratic pride, her speech measured, logical, and conveying the unyielding resolve of a natural feudal ruler.
